description: Trigger an alarm hub output channel. Can be used to turn on/off connected devices like sirens, lights, or other actuators.

requestBody.name: enable
requestBody.description: Set to true to turn on, false to turn off. If omitted, toggles the current state.

requestBody.name: delay
requestBody.description: Delay in milliseconds before the output activates

requestBody.name: duration
requestBody.description: Duration in milliseconds to keep the output active. 0 means indefinite until manually turned off.

local.python:
import http.client
import json


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("192.168.0.1")
payload = json.dumps({
  "enable": True,
  "delay": 0,
  "duration": 0
})
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
conn.request("POST", "/proxy/protect/integration/v1/alarm-hubs/{id}/outputs/{outputId}/trigger", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
local.ansible:
- name: Trigger alarm hub output
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.protect:
    path: "/v1/alarm-hubs/{id}/outputs/{outputId}/trigger"
    method: POST
    body:
      enable: true
      delay: 0
      duration: 0
  register: result


- debug:
    var: result.data
